Popatlal gets caught at the restaurant after the Gokuldham members realize he was the one making mysterious missed calls. It turns out he mistakenly noted down Babita's phone number instead of a woman named Vaijayanti's number by changing just one digit (writing 54 instead of 53).
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
